dynamicsSeparation.rule: Positive acceleration and deceleration magnitude statistics are computed separately — signed values must not cancel

energyProxySemantics.futurePhysicalEnergy: If trusted vehicle mass becomes available later, physical energy may be added as a separate field
energyProxySemantics.rule: Without trusted vehicle mass, do NOT call values physical kinetic energy (Joules)
energyProxySemantics.units: m²/s² aggregate (½Δv² per episode interval — no vehicle mass)

exposureNormalization: REQUIRED — 5 km city vs 500 km motorway must be comparable
purpose: Comparable trip-level features for history, benchmarking, future scoring
